designDifferences: Workbook child size_bytes and size_class are null before extraction; zero would invent a size. Top-level sizes remain required. Parts, keys and extent tables exist but receive no IN1 rows.
migrateIntakeLedgerTx loads the hand-authored, hash-pinned SQL through the existing loader; central migrateUsp wiring is outside ownership and remains undone. SQL was applied nowhere.
Budget retries keep the item received and retry the bounded pure probe; no partial parser checkpoint is persisted. A later failed/budget probe cannot erase an existing card or officer pin.
Nested ZIPs are retained at signature depth rather than recursively opened. This is stricter than the depth-two ceiling; it avoids extracting child originals in this task.
File Geodatabase has no reliable single-head classification here and remains unknown with a stated limit. COG is recognized only as TIFF/GeoTIFF, never asserted as COG.

PDF encryption/page counts require validated trailer/page-tree resolution and remain null. LAS VLR CRS is unresolved. TIFF IFD dimensions/bands/tiling/GeoKeys are bounded, but transform, overviews and COG layout are not qualified. BigTIFF stays signature-only.

PRJ bytes are hashed only when the entire sidecar fits the member head. CRS code resolution, raster world-file transforms, and non-4326 extent conversion are deferred to existing native readers. Sidecar hashes never become guessed CRS codes.

GeoPackage layers and GeoParquet row groups/CRS/extent remain unplanned, as permitted by this task's signature-only scope. NYC manifest.json stays unknown; its declared values are not copied into cards.
source.retained notifications are emitted only for canonical status needs_input, its schema's required literal. Other source statuses publish nothing; no stream or Studio contract was changed.
Existing receipt counts/CRS/types and accepted-result hashes are cited, not recalculated by a native job. Retained-count coverage is explicitly distinguished from a recomputed raw-file total.

Non-UTF8 high-byte ZIP names are refused rather than mislabeled with a CP437/Windows-1252 guess. Member count, directory size, expanded bytes, ratio, unsafe paths and depth guards are protocol-tested.
reviewFindingsFixed: Case-folding ZIP folders/base names could borrow another item's CRS sidecar. Grouping now requires exact folder/base equality; a regression checks differently cased folders and bases.

Arbitrary GeoParquet version text could escape as a metadata code. Only numeric semantic-version codes are accepted; a protocol control checks that an untyped value never appears in the serialized card.
